accountId.description: The account to check for query changes.

filter.description: Must match the filter used in the original Email/query call.

sort.description: Must match the sort used in the original Email/query call.

sinceQueryState.description: The queryState from the previous Email/query or Email/queryChanges response.

maxChanges.description: Maximum number of changes to return. If exceeded, hasMoreChanges will be true.

upToId.description: Return changes only up to and including this EmailId.
